name: O'Shea 2023
question: After apical prolapse reconstruction, are unrestricted postoperative activity instructions noninferior to standard restrictions for anatomic support and prolapse symptoms?

design.blinding: Surgeons and outcome assessors masked; participants unmasked
design.population: Physically active, English-speaking women with bothersome stage II–IV pelvic organ prolapse scheduled for vaginal or robotic laparoscopic apical reconstruction at a single academic center.

verdictNote: Both coprimary noninferiority margins were met at three months among 107 analyzed participants.
takeaway: After vaginal or robotic laparoscopic apical prolapse surgery, expedited activity without lifting or work restrictions was noninferior to standard six-week lifting restrictions for anatomic support and prolapse symptoms at three months.

reports.label: Three-month primary report
reports.citation: O'Shea M, Siddiqui NY, Truong T, Erkanli A, Barber MD. "Standard Restrictions vs Expedited Activity After Pelvic Organ Prolapse Surgery: A Randomized Clinical Trial." *JAMA Surg.* 2023;158(8):797-805. doi:10.1001/jamasurg.2023.1649
reports.followUp: Three-month POP-Q examination and symptom assessment
reports.followUpLocator: Methods, postoperative follow-up; Results, three-month outcomes

results.measure: Three-month mean SLmax (cm); baseline-adjusted mean difference, expedited minus standard
results.note: Prespecified noninferiority margin: +1.0 cm; upper 95% CI below margin. Baseline-SLmax-adjusted model from Results text.

results.endpoint: Pelvic Organ Prolapse Distress Inventory (POPDI) score
results.measure: Three-month mean POPDI score (points); baseline-adjusted mean difference, expedited minus standard
results.note: Prespecified noninferiority margin: +34.3 points; upper 95% CI below margin. Baseline-POPDI-adjusted model from Results text.

results.measure: Median days to return to work in employed participants
results.note: Small employed subset; denominators not given in the main article.

harms.label: Postoperative complications
harms.note: The main article reports no between-group difference; event-specific counts are in Supplement 2 eTable 6.

delivery.label: Postoperative instructions

values.exp: No lifting or work restrictions; resume as able
values.ctl: No lifting over 10 lb for 6 weeks; sedentary work after 2 weeks and manual labor after 6 weeks

delivery.note: Both groups avoided sexual activity until the six-week postoperative visit.

delivery.label: Robotic laparoscopic mesh sacrocolpopexy
delivery.note: Synthetic polypropylene mesh; 57 analyzed participants underwent vaginal apical repair.

relations.note: Earlier liberal-versus-restricted activity trial informed the rationale; O'Shea tested prespecified noninferiority of prolapse outcomes.
